font_source_style.method: Every final Hangul occurrence must match the authored original source role, exact point size and original prose baseline. Every actual embedded font/GID outline must match the complete role-donor Unicode glyph; no family name or nonempty-outline shortcut.

all_new_prose.method: Exact authored-prose suffix journal identifies original native paint prefix; final translated prose is checked by actual PDF resource/GID embedded outlines, without counting moved original mathematical glyphs as new prose.

source_language.method: Exact selected source glyphs, including through/substring slots; source math fonts and explicit physical field labels protected; remaining narrative words must be original unit symbols or specifically reviewed native math labels.

original_source_heading_alignment.method: Independently read every final nonspace glyph envelope against its original source center. Also inventory every original bold14pt-or-larger English prose heading, including subtitles, and require its alignment intent and actual center to be present.
